title: Nothing auto-runs verifyNote; feedback correction bypasses verification
answers: Why do stale notes stay stale?
Does any hook re-verify notes automatically?
Can a note be changed without hash/LLM check?
body: In hook contexts (freshOnly=true), stale notes are held back and not served—background verification is scheduled for them instead of treating them as still-served. The feedback function behavior is unchanged: negative feedback below 0.3 confidence sets status='invalid'; a correction overwrites body and sets verified timestamp directly without hash recheck.
applies: Applies to the current CLI/hook wiring; if a hook or post-commit is changed to pass --verify, verification would run automatically.
